# fm.cr

> Crystal bindings for Apple FoundationModels.framework

This is the documentation for fm.cr, Crystal bindings for Apple FoundationModels.framework.

## Pages

- [fm.cr](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/): Crystal bindings for Apple FoundationModels.framework

## API Reference

- [Context](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/context/): Context window management and session compaction
- [Errors](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/errors/): Error types and exception handling
- [Generable & Guide](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/generable/): Type-safe structured output with schema generation
- [GenerationOptions](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/generation-options/): Control generation parameters
- [Session](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/session/): Conversation session management
- [SystemLanguageModel](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/system-language-model/): The on-device language model interface
- [Tools](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/tools/): Tool calling API reference

## User Guide

- [Basic Usage](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/basic-usage/): Models, sessions, and generating responses
- [Context Management](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/context-management/): Transcripts, token estimation, and session compaction
- [Getting Started](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/getting-started/): Prerequisites, installation, and your first fm.cr program
- [Streaming](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/streaming/): Stream responses from the model in real time
- [Structured Output](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/structured-output/): Type-safe responses with Generable and JSON schemas
- [Tool Calling](https://fm.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/tool-calling/): Extend model capabilities with custom tools
